initialPrompt: build a website for our business

design.independentReview: Separate source/artifact inspection and copy-only deterministic checks; no performer/model calls or original-output edits

discovery.method: Natural prompt; no selected-process ID supplied to performer. Actual calls and guide retrieval are recorded per arm.
discovery.composition: 64 previously exposed mappings plus seven newly exposed selected standalone candidate mappings.
discovery.productionVisibilityLimit: This local candidate catalog is not an exact production-visibility test.
discovery.result: No UM performer attempt or guide retrieval. The catalog description is planned fixture context only.

candidate.recordRole: Planned candidate binding only; UM did not start and no guide was retrieved

runtime.deliverySurface: Native app-server with isolated local candidate MCP; marketplace installation not tested
runtime.isolation: Separate synthetic writable workspaces; personal connectors/plugins disabled; shell network disabled; public search enabled
runtime.sharedInstructionCaveat: Both arms inherited the same global workflow preferences. Raw personal instructions/configuration are excluded.
runtime.runtimeReproducibilityLimit: Private runtime logs, authentication and configuration are excluded; this is evidence and artifact replay, not a complete native runner reproduction.

prospectiveResetGuardAddendum.timing: After migration UM -03 completed; before prod_010 either arm. Original interrupted runs preserved.
prospectiveResetGuardAddendum.basis: Captured RPC/event reset reporting differs by one second; exact backend cause unknown. Primary client source forwards absolute epochs.
prospectiveResetGuardAddendum.policy: Optional ±1 second against immutable original account/plan/bucket/window/reset reference, only when both reset epochs are more than630seconds away. Raw values retained.
prospectiveResetGuardAddendum.reportedVerification: 64 deterministic checks, including complete synthetic two-runtime controller exercise; recorded pricing/migration telemetry replay; fresh native read-only preflight.
prospectiveResetGuardAddendum.interpretation: Harness-interrupted missing deliverables are not guide defects. Complete fair reruns remain subject to available included capacity.
prospectiveResetGuardAddendum.unchangedBoundaries: Approval policy never; account, credit, isolation and reserve-stop controls retained.
prospectiveResetGuardAddendum.privateReferenceExcluded: Authenticated fixed-reference hash and raw account telemetry omitted.

limits.reason: Earlier CRM attempts reached the lower gross-token ceiling. The two planned website arms had the same increased ceiling before this attempt; only the control started. Earlier partial attempts remain recorded.
limits.unchangedControls: Model, effort, tier, files, tool availability, factual-answer policy, sequential order, wall/output limits and accounting/isolation stops.
limits.reactiveMonitoring: Telemetry and interruption are reactive, not a hard in-flight billing cap. No account identifiers, numeric credit balances or account-usage percentages are included.

without-um.collectorCaveat: Collector turnCount/nativeTurnSeconds omit this interrupted turn; zero would not mean no work. Started-turn count and local event-receipt elapsed time are reported separately.

factualFollowups.source: Frozen factual-answer packet; actual recorded reply. Internal source path omitted.

with-um.reason: Deferred to preserve remaining campaign capacity; no guide exposure, output or quality result.

redactions: Raw native events, private configuration/instructions and local runtime databases excluded
Account identifiers, balances, credentials, private endpoints and account-usage telemetry excluded
Transcript native IDs omitted and artifact paths rebased
Synthetic source/output bytes preserved; executable filenames gain .txt
externalEffects: No external execution is established by this package. See the independent review for exact completion boundaries.

completion.kind: Interrupted control only; UM not started
completion.limit: Token telemetry and interruption are reactive; the ceiling is not a hard in-flight cap.
completion.interpretation: No completed pair or guide-quality conclusion. Missing final validation/handoff followed harness termination.
